text: Yesterday after school, I played Minecraft with my best friend Leo. We built a huge castle made of diamond blocks, but then a creeper blew up the front door! "Oh no!" Leo yelled. "Get your sword!" We fixed the wall and then we switched to Roblox to play a parkour game. I fell off the edge like five times. It was so funny. Later, I watched Pokemon on TV. Ash was trying to catch a new Pikachu, but Team Rocket showed up again. They are so annoying, but I love watching them blast off.

Today was a very good day. I woke up early and had toast for breakfast. It was sunny outside so I played in the park with my dog. His name is Spot and he likes to run fast. We played catch with a red ball. Then my mom made lunch. We had big sandwiches and apple juice. After lunch, I read my favorite book about space. It has lots of cool pictures of stars. Now I am tired and ready for bed. I hope tomorrow is fun too.

One day me and my best friend went to play in the woods behind my house. We were pretending to be brave heroes on a secret mission. Suddenly, I saw something shiny in the bushes. "Look!" I yelled. It was a toy sword! I picked it up and held it straight out. "I am a powerful knight!" I shouted. My friend laughed and said, "That is cool enough for me!" We ran through the trees until it got dark. I thought it was the best day ever.

Today I had a really fun day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It was very good. Then I went to the park with my dad. We played catch with a big red ball. I ran very fast. We saw a cute dog there too. The dog had brown fur. After that, we went home for lunch. I had a cheese sandwich. Then I played video games with my brother. I won the game! Now I am tired and ready for bed. It was the best day ever.

I can't believe what happened at recess today! We were playing tag near the big slide, and suddenly Tommy found a huge frog. Wow! It was slimy and green. Oh man, it jumped right out of his hands! We chased it everywhere. Through the grass. Under the bench. No way were we letting it get away. Finally, Sarah caught it in her lunchbox. It's safe now, but Mrs. Miller said we can't keep it. Bummer. We're going to release it by the pond after school. I hope it finds its mom!

Yesterday was the best day ever because my mom let me play on my iPad for two hours. First, I played Roblox with my friend Sam. We played a game called Adopt Me and I got a legendary pet dragon. It was so cool! Then we switched to Minecraft. I built a huge house made of diamonds, but a creeper blew up the front door. I was kind of mad. After that, I watched a new Spider-Man cartoon on TV while I ate popcorn. I wish I could play video games all day long.

Today was a really fun day. I woke up early and ate toast for breakfast. It had lots of butter on it. Then I went to the park with my dad. We played catch with my red ball. I can throw it very far now. We saw a big dog running fast. It was funny. After the park, we ate lunch. I had a cheese sandwich and an apple. Now I am tired. I will read my book and go to sleep soon. It was a good day.

I love Saturdays because I can play Roblox all morning with my friend Sam. We usually play a game where you have to run away from a giant Piggy. It is super scary but funny too. Last week, we built a huge castle in Minecraft. It had a secret room full of gold. Then my mom said, "Turn off the TV and come eat lunch!" I was sad because I wanted to watch Spider-Man cartoons, but she let me play my Nintendo Switch later. I caught a really cool Pikachu in Pokemon.

I love playing Roblox with my best friend Sam. Yesterday we played a game where we had to build a giant pizza shop. Sam made the pepperoni and I made the cheese. "Watch out for the zombies!" Sam yelled. A big green zombie tried to eat our pizza, but I used my super speed to run away. After that, we switched to Minecraft to build a secret base under the water. It was so cool until my mom said, "Turn it off, it's dinner time!" I didn't want to stop, but I was hungry.

My big sister, Sarah, told me a story about a brave knight. He lived on a tiny island way out in the ocean. One day, he got caught in a giant storm! The wind blew straight through his shiny armor. He thought he was going to sink, but then he saw a big boat. It was the king’s daughter coming to save him! She threw him a rope just in time. "That was close enough!" the knight yelled. Then they sailed home to get some hot cocoa.

I love Saturdays because my dad lets me play video games all morning. First, I went on Roblox and played a game called Adopt Me with my friend Sam. We got a new pet dragon! Then Sam said, "Let's go play Fortnite now." I am not very good at Fortnite yet, but it is super fun. After lunch, I watched a Spider-Man cartoon on TV. Spider-Man is really cool because he can swing from big buildings. It was the best day ever.

My favorite thing to do after school is play Roblox with my best friend, Alex. We usually play a game called Brookhaven where we can drive cool cars and build giant houses. Yesterday, we tried to play Fortnite, but I am not very good at it yet. I kept getting eliminated right away! So we decided to watch Pokemon on TV instead. Pikachu is so funny when he uses his thunderbolt attack. My mom said I had to turn it off for dinner, but I really wanted to catch them all.

One day, a brave knight went on a big adventure to a scary island. He wanted to find the King's daughter who was lost. He walked straight through the dark woods and didn't stop. Suddenly, he saw a giant net and got caught in it! He thought he was stuck forever, but he was strong enough to break the ropes. He ran back to the castle as fast as he could. I think he needs a nap now because adventures make you really tired.

One day a brave **knight** went to a big scary castle. He wanted to save the king's **daughter**. But oh no! A dragon was sleeping right in front of the door. The knight **thought** hard about what to do. He walked **straight** past the dragon really quietly. He didn't make any noise at all. The dragon just kept sleeping and snoring very loud. Finally, he got inside and yelled, "Let's go home!" They ran away fast before the dragon woke up. It was super scary but fun.

I love playing video games after school. My favorite game is Minecraft because I can build huge castles and fight zombies. Yesterday, my friend Sam came over and we played Roblox together on my iPad. It was so funny when our characters fell in the lava. Sometimes we watch Pokemon on TV too. I want to catch Pikachu, but he is very fast. My mom said if I finish my homework, I can play Fortnite for thirty minutes before dinner. I hope I win!

Yesterday my friend Sam came over to my house. We played Minecraft on my tablet. I built a huge castle with green blocks, but then a Creeper blew up the door! Sam laughed really loud. My mom said we had to turn it off for dinner, but I really wanted to play Roblox instead. Maybe we can play next time.

My big brother Jake promised he’d teach me how to skateboard today. Finally! I’ve been waiting all week. We went to the park, and it was super crowded. Oh man! I was kinda scared I’d fall in front of everyone. "Don't worry," Jake said. "Just balance." Yeah, right. Easier said than done! I got on the board and wobbled like crazy. Whoa! I almost crashed into a tree. But then, I actually rolled for like five seconds. No way! It was awesome. I can’t wait to go back tomorrow.

After that, I tried to play Fortnite, but I kept losing, so I switched to Minecraft. I made a secret house out of dirt so the zombies couldn't find me at night. It was super fun.

It looked like a giant gold coin, but when I picked it up, it was just an old bottle cap. Oh man! We were so disappointed. "Let's keep looking," my brother said. "Maybe there's real treasure." We searched for hours until it got dark. We're definitely going back tomorrow though. I just know there's something cool out there!

No way am I missing the chance to see a crab underwater. See ya later!

I couldn't believe my eyes! There was a huge, furry dog sitting right in the middle of our treehouse. "No way!" shouted my brother, pointing at the ladder. "How did he even get up there?" The dog just wagged its tail and barked. It looked so happy. "We're going to be in so much trouble if Mom finds out," I whispered. Oh man! We climbed up fast. The dog licked my face. Gross! But he was actually really cute. "Can we keep him?" my brother asked. I sighed. "I don't know, but we can't leave him here!"

We were playing tag at recess when Tommy tripped over a giant root. Oh man! He scraped his knee really bad, and there was dirt everywhere. "I can't get up!" he yelled. Everyone stopped running. "Don't worry," I said. "We're going to get help." I ran as fast as a cheetah to Mrs. Gable. She came over with a big band-aid. Wow! It had dinosaurs on it. Tommy stopped crying right away. "Cool!" he said. Then the bell rang. No way! Recess was already over? At least Tommy was okay.

We’re finally going to the water park today! I can’t wait. My mom said we have to pack our own lunch, but that’s okay because she bought the good chips. Oh man! I almost forgot my goggles. I ran back to my room to grab them. If I don't have them, the water stings my eyes way too much. No way am I swimming without them. My little brother is already sitting in the car honking the horn. So annoying. But hey, at least we’re leaving now. Best day ever!

My big sister acted like a brave knight in our backyard. She wore a shiny pot on her head. "I am going to save the princess!" she yelled. She ran straight through the bushes to find her lost doll. I thought she was going to get stuck, but she didn't. When she finally caught the doll, she shouted, "I have enough power to win!" It was funny because the doll was just sitting on a big rock like it was on a tiny island.

Oh man! I can't believe we actually found it. The old treehouse in the woods wasn't just a myth after all. "Look at that rope ladder!" I shouted to Max. It’s super high up, but we're definitely climbing it. Max looked scared, but I wasn't. No way! I grabbed the first rung and pulled. It held. "Come on, don't be a chicken!" Inside, there was an old wooden box covered in dust. Wow! Treasure? Maybe. We're going to be rich! Or maybe it's just old comic books. Either way, this is the best Saturday ever.
